description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag for generating URLs to download digital products in an admin interface of an e-commerce application. It constructs a URL based on merchant store info, configuration, and file path utilities.

classes.name: AdminProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag for generating download URLs for digital products in the admin interface.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and writes the download URL for a digital product based on store and request configurations.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the JSP tag processing cycle.
